data.content:
On the Cincinnati side, Julian Malatini is doubtful due to a leg injury, while Nick Hagglund is unlikely to clear concussion protocol and Obinna Nwobodo is out because of a yellow card suspension.

Tom Barlow became just the second Cincy player to appear in all 34 regular-season outings the last time out, while Evander had double digits in goals and assists in 2026, finishing tied for second in the league with Lionel Messi in regular-season assists (17).

Orlando City possible starting lineup: [...] Due to a back injury, Griffin Dorsey is questionable for Orlando City, while foot issues are likely to keep Tyrese Spicer and Robin Jansson out of the fold on Thursday and Iago Teodoro is eligible to return from his suspension.

Braian Ojeda had the only goal against New England on Decision Day while Maxime Crepeau collected his fifth clean sheet of the campaign. [...] The Orange and Blue are unbeaten in their last four MLS meeting versus Orlando City, while Noonan has never lost a match against them at Inter.co Stadium.

data.title: Orlando City vs FC Cincinnati Prediction: 20.11.2026 Major League Soccer 2026 Ro... | Tips.GG
data.content:
Orlando line up in a 3-4-1-2 formation. Crépeau has started every recent match and recorded 14 saves, so he remains the clear choice in goal. Martin Ojeda sits behind the front two as the attacking midfielder, and he has taken 14 shots in the last five matches. We expect Braian Ojeda to provide the link to the wide areas, and Atuesta to protect the central channel.

### FC Cincinnati possible starting eleven [...] Cincinnati set up in a 4-4-2 formation. Celentano has played every minute of the last five matches and made 15 saves, which makes him a reliable presence. Denkey has logged the most minutes among the forwards, and Ramirez offers pace on the other side. Tom Barlow could return to the front line if the coaching staff wants more direct threat, with his eight shots and one goal making him a useful option.

Cincinnati have the better form over the last 30 days and the stronger ball progression, but Orlando’s shape and counter threat should keep the tie level. To be honest, the margin is slim, and the draw offers the best return for our money.
